author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Hey, Goldie here!

So, for this week, I got 32 monuments: a personal record. But I've also been on a ton these last couple of days. That's why I'd really like to see how many monuments I get per hour/minute-- I love numbers and calculations. It can also be helpful if someone wants to see how good they really are at rushing. Basically, it will be just like the discussion activity chart, except it will be of how many hours and minutes you've been on (Say you've been on for 3 hours 25 minutes on Monday. On the chart, at 6/23/14, it will say "Online: 3 hours, 25 minutes". What do you think about this? :3
If you have any ideas, criticism, or approval, please comment below!
